name: LiteLLM
one_liner: One interface for calling many model providers.
what_it_is: An open source AI gateway giving a single unified interface to call many LLM providers — its own README names OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock and Azure among them — using the OpenAI request format. It can be used as a library or run as a proxy in front of the providers.
why_it_matters: It makes the provider a configuration value rather than a rewrite, which matters when pricing, availability or policy changes decide where a request goes. What it cannot do is hide the differences that matter: providers vary in tool-calling, structured output and context handling, and code written against the shared shape can still break when it moves.
suitable_for: Applications expected to change or mix providers
Routing requests by cost or availability
Central logging and spend limits across teams
not_suitable_for: A single provider used through features the shared format does not express
Latency-critical paths where a proxy hop is measurable
Teams who want to read the provider API directly with nothing between
